title: Fresh Water
description: Enhanced Water is a Minecraft resource pack that improves the appearance of water while keeping the vanilla style intact. It features clearer textures, better transparency, smoother visuals, and a more immersive look for oceans, rivers, and lakes

- **Fresh Water** is Experience the best of Vanilla, Cartoon, and Realistic water visuals in one resource pack a vanilla-friendly Minecraft resource pack designed to improve water visuals without changing the game's original style.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Features**
1. > • Clearer and cleaner water textures
2. > • Improved transparency
3. > • Better visual depth
4. > • Enhanced appearance for oceans, rivers, and lakes
5. > • Compatible with most resource packs
6. > Enjoy a more beautiful and immersive Minecraft world while preserving the classic vanilla experience.
